exposure: Elderly primigravida (pregnancy for the first time at 35 years or older)
outcome: Maternal complications (oligohydramnios, gestational hypertension, breech presentation, PROM, placenta previa, gestational diabetes, twin pregnancy)
cohort: The study included 306 elderly primigravida women out of a total of 18,050 deliveries.
finding: The study found that elderly primigravida women had a higher incidence of maternal complications and cesarean section rates, but with adequate antenatal care and timely intervention, optimal outcomes can be expected.
birth_weight: Measured, with 6.6% classified as low birth weight
